description: Approved, bounded work queue. A job may run only through scripts/agent-queue.mjs and must hand off before another dependent job starts.

jobs.scope: src/content/story.ts, src/content/locations.ts, src/content/beats-data.ts, src/engine/story.ts, test/endings.test.ts, test/story-consequences.test.ts
jobs.objective: Review the interrupted Phase 4 work; complete at most one consequential-choice invariant and prove it with focused tests.
acceptance: Preserve unrelated dirty changes and do not touch E2E, reducer, UI, AI, or RPG files.
A Hoi I route choice unlocks or locks a real reachable node or NPC with a deterministic downstream state difference.
Focused story/content tests pass, or a detailed handoff records the exact failing invariant.
verification: npx vitest run test/endings.test.ts test/story-consequences.test.ts test/content.test.ts

jobs.scope: src/content/rpg.ts, src/engine/content-types.ts, src/engine/reducer.ts, src/engine/constants.ts, src/engine/stats.ts, src/ui/CodexPanel.tsx, test/rpg-systems.test.ts
jobs.objective: Review the interrupted Phase 3 changes; complete at most one real two-sided technique trade-off and prove its deterministic, player-visible effect.
acceptance: Do not touch story, E2E, AI, schema, or session files.
The selected technique has both a benefit and a mechanically enforced cost shown to the player.
Focused RPG tests pass, or a detailed handoff records the exact failing invariant.

jobs.objective: Diagnose one fresh-run ending route visibility failure and make the minimal helper or route correction without weakening proof requirements.
acceptance: Do not inject flags, bypass physical movement, weaken assertions, or change production game rules.
Capture the actual map location/position and visible node state for the failing path.
The selected focused Playwright route passes, or a detailed handoff records the exact root cause.
verification: npx playwright test e2e/fresh-endings.spec.ts --grep "Rootless Star|Spring for an Enemy"

jobs.scope: docs/plans/system-layer/**, src/content/system-defs.ts, src/content/system-quests.ts, src/engine/system-runtime.ts, src/engine/quests.ts, src/engine/reducer.ts, src/engine/types.ts, src/engine/schema.ts, src/engine/content-types.ts, src/content/story.ts, src/content/index.ts, src/ai/system.ts, src/ui/GameScreen.tsx, src/i18n/vi.ts, src/i18n/en.ts, test/system-*.test.ts, test/ai-system.test.ts, e2e/system-pick.spec.ts
jobs.objective: Implement the System Layer plan (docs/plans/system-layer/): 10 system definitions, pick-one-at-boot, system quest pool (q_sys_*), LLM chat boundary (src/ai/system.ts), and scenario-agnostic design. Runs ONLY after x20 T12+T13 handoffs are reviewed and the merged tree is green (typecheck/lint/vitest/build/playwright).
acceptance: SYSTEMS.length === 10 with unique ids/orders; system quests use requiredSystemId + giverNpcId null and never set storySceneNextId.
Boot scene lets the player pick exactly one System; re-pick is rejected (hard-lock); rootless path stays silent.
System quest accept/turn-in works through the System panel without requiring an NPC/location; rewards stay within each system's budget.
src/ai/system.ts follows the narration.ts pattern: validates questId against the pool, deterministic fallback when AI disabled, never writes state.
Scenario-independence containment test passes: system-layer core files import no authored Scenario-I modules (story/npcs/locations/endings/chapters/quests).
All 5 gates green and results posted in handoff: npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npx vitest run, npm run build, npx playwright test (at least e2e/system-pick.spec.ts).
verification: npx vitest run test/system-defs.test.ts test/system-schema.test.ts test/system-quests.test.ts test/system-engine.test.ts test/system-boot.test.ts test/ai-system.test.ts test/system-ui.test.tsx test/system-scenario.test.ts
